through_line.name: les neurones miroirs
through_line.progression: invisibles en bloc un (le baillement se propage sans explication) -> reveles en bloc deux (le petit amas s'allume dans le cerveau quand on regarde) -> en action en bloc trois (le circuit copie le geste avant meme la decision) -> mesure en bloc quatre (plus le lien est fort, plus l'amas brille)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final transforme le badge en jauge : l'intensite de l'amas depend de la proximite avec la personne — le baillement devient un test d'attachement, ce qui repond au chien du hook

blocks.vo_line: Ton chien bâille quand tu bâilles. Ce réflexe saute d'un cerveau à l'autre sans un mot, et personne ne décide vraiment de le déclencher.
blocks.through_line_state: invisible : le baillement saute d'un personnage a l'autre puis au chien, sans explication visible
shots: WIDE static establishing: the pastel living room; the young person sits on the lavender sofa and yawns wide, shoulders rising
MEDIUM low angle: the second person standing near the sofa catches it — their mouth opens in a yawn a beat later, eyes squeezing shut
CLOSE-UP: the small sandy dog on the rug looks up, then yawns too, its floppy ears wobbling
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the dog's face mid-yawn, one baby blue sparkle popping above its head
MEDIUM: all three sit still, blinking at each other, then the rounded neuron-cluster badge swings in from the right and settles with a bounce

blocks.vo_line: Dans ton cerveau vit un petit groupe de cellules, les neurones miroirs. Ils s'allument quand tu fais un geste, mais aussi quand tu le vois chez quelqu'un.
blocks.through_line_state: reveles : l'amas mint s'allume dans le cerveau, d'abord pour le geste fait, puis pour le geste vu
shots: WIDE static establishing: the pastel brain diagram; the mint cluster near the front pulses softly twice, thin blue lines glowing between the nodes
MEDIUM lateral with a gentle drift right: one node lights up bright, then passes a travelling spark along a blue line to its neighbour
CLOSE-UP high angle: three nodes light in sequence, each popping with a tiny sparkle as it fires
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: a single node's surface, glowing and dimming like a slow heartbeat
MEDIUM low angle across the cluster: the whole group flares up at once and settles back into a soft steady glow

blocks.vo_line: Voir un bâillement suffit donc à activer le circuit qui le déclenche. Ton cerveau imite avant que tu décides : tu bâilles déjà quand tu comprends pourquoi.
blocks.through_line_state: en action : l'amas s'allume au moment ou le regard capte le baillement, et la copie part avant la decision
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the young person's eyes widen as they watch something off-frame, a mint glow flickering at their temple
MEDIUM high angle with a slow tilt down: the neuron badge hovering beside their head lights up node by node, faster and faster
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: their mouth starting to open on its own, a small surprised eyebrow lift above
MEDIUM: they clap a hand over their mouth too late — the yawn wins, shoulders dropping with it
CLOSE-UP low angle: they shrug at the camera with a resigned smile, the badge sparkling once beside them

blocks.vo_line: Plus tu es proche de la personne, plus tu attrapes son bâillement. Ce petit réflexe mesure donc ton empathie : abonne-toi, demain on regarde les frissons.
blocks.through_line_state: mesure : le badge devient une jauge, l'amas brille faiblement pour un inconnu et intensement pour un proche — le chien du hook trouve sa reponse
shots: WIDE static establishing: the living room; the two people sit together on the sofa, the dog curled between them
EXTREME CLOSE-UP straight on the badge: the cluster glows faintly, only two nodes lit, a small gap between them
CLOSE-UP lateral on the badge: the cluster flares bright as all nodes light at once, sparkles bursting outward
MEDIUM: the second person yawns, the first person catches it instantly, and the dog yawns last with a happy wobble
CLOSE-UP low angle: the young person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy bell pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
